description: external_permission_mode.codex resolves to parent-mediated (the shipped default). Pattern 3 is not implemented against the real `codex app-server` protocol, so the adapter logs one WARN line and runs Pattern 1 (`codex exec --sandbox read-only --ephemeral`). It never probes `codex app-server --help` (that exits 0 on Codex CLI 0.160.0 whether or not the adapter could drive the protocol) and never invokes `codex app-server`.
expected_warnings: codex: parent-mediated (Pattern 3) is not implemented; running read-only.

findings.title: Missing CSRF check in handleLogin
findings.description: The handleLogin function does not validate CSRF tokens, allowing cross-site request forgery attacks.
